skill_name: Compare and contrast chairs and desks.
workflow: Chairs and desks both serve as useful pieces of furniture, but they serve different purposes and have distinct features. Chairs are typically designed for sitting and are often mobile, while desks are meant for a stationary work surface or writing surface. Chairs come in a variety of styles and materials and can range from a basic upholstered chair to a complex ergonomic chair with adjustable positions and support.
